create_HunyuanConfig: create a HunyuanConfig pipeline configuration for text-to-video generation with DiT, VAE, and text encoders
create_FastHunyuanConfig: create a FastHunyuanConfig pipeline configuration optimized for FastHunyuan weights with flow_shift set to 17
run_llama_preprocess_text: run llama_preprocess_text to format a video description prompt with the Hunyuan system prompt template
run_llama_postprocess_text: run llama_postprocess_text to extract hidden states from Llama encoder output and crop the template tokens
run_clip_postprocess_text: run clip_postprocess_text to extract the pooler output from CLIP encoder output
